label: Awards and recognitions
rationale: Successful public petition examples organize awards as discrete exhibit-backed recognition evidence.

label: Memberships
rationale: Successful examples keep membership proof mapped directly to the USCIS membership criterion.

label: Judging

values: \b(peer review|peer reviewer|review invitation|review completion|reviewer certificate|judge|judging|program committee|technical committee)\b

rationale: Successful public petitions commonly treat peer-review and judging records as direct criterion evidence when document type and file context agree.

label: Original Contributions
rationale: Successful examples emphasize contribution significance with objective adoption, impact, citation, or implementation evidence.

label: Authorship
rationale: Successful examples use publication packages and templates to map scholarly authorship, venue, and exhibit citations cleanly.

label: Leading or Critical Role

values: \b(critical role|leading role|leadership|architect|principal|led|owner|head of|senior .* role|recommendation letter|reference letter|manager letter)\b

rationale: Successful examples map role letters, project leadership, and organizational impact into exhibit-backed leading or critical role arguments.

label: High Salary
rationale: Successful examples isolate compensation records so salary evidence can be evaluated without manual file-by-file triage.
